site_or_case_name: (a) US59 (Multi-profile figure also includes (b) HH, (c) G1 Site, (d) G2 Site, and (e) BB Site; primary profile extracted for US59 and others summarized in notes)
additional_notes: Depths converted using the figure note 1 ft = 30.5 cm (0.305 m). Numbers inside the logs represent Standard Penetration Test (SPT) blow counts; *T indicates thermocouple locations and numbered segments indicate load cells along the shaft. Other profiles shown in the figure: (b) HH (no groundwater marked): CL from 0.0 to 4.0 m, CL from 4.0 to 6.7 m, SP with thin clay seams from 6.7 to 9.8 m (SPT N > 100); (c) G1 Site (groundwater at 5.2 m / 17 ft): CH from 0.0 to 5.2 m, ML from 5.2 to 6.7 m, CH from 6.7 to 10.4 m, SP from 10.4 to 19.5 m (SPT N = 30, 25, 12, 14, 23, 31, 24); (d) G2 Site (groundwater at 4.0 m / 13 ft): CH from 0.0 to 19.5 m, SP from 19.5 to 23.5 m (SPT N = 40, 70), CH from 23.5 to 25.0 m; (e) BB Site (groundwater at 8.2 m / 27 ft): CL from 0.0 to 1.7 m, CL-ML from 1.7 to 4.3 m, CL from 4.3 to 6.1 m, SP from 6.1 to 16.5 m (SPT N > 100 above 13.4 m, 60 above a thin clay seam at ~14.3 m, and 50 below).
